history: always-repro'd across v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607 (19 stable releases, linear scan, no invalid probes inside the range); v1.4.1907 is an invalid probe (no RayQuery, no SM6.5); prerelease v1.5.2003 also repros
summary: Declaring a RayQuery that is never used fails DXIL validation: 'Flags must match usage. / note: Flags declared=33554432, actual=0'. Still repros on main (1.9.0.5433, 13730886e) and in every stable release since RayQuery shipped. DxilFinalizeModule collects shader flags (DxilPreparePasses.cpp:1001) before RemoveUnusedRayQuery erases the unused allocateRayQuery (line 1012), so the module declares raytracing tier 1.1 while the validator recomputes 0 from the final IR (DxilValidation.cpp:4881). Template ray flags are irrelevant (RAY_FLAG_NONE repros); -Od does not help; -validator-version 1.7 compiles clean via a >=1.5/<1.8 compatibility shim.
title: error: Flags must match usage.
